# NewsAPI.ai

> NewsAPI.ai is the news API of Event Registry: real-time and archive (since 2014) access to news, blog and press-release articles from 150,000+ publishers in 50+ languages. Every article is enriched with entities (concepts linked to Wikipedia), categories, sentiment, locations and duplicate information; related articles are clustered into events, and Signal Types classify 136+ kinds of real-world developments (mergers, layoffs, protests, wildfires, ...) at the sentence level. Access is via a REST API (JSON over GET or POST), Python and Node.js SDKs, and an MCP server.

Key facts for using the API:

- Authentication: every request carries an `apiKey` parameter. Registration at https://newsapi.ai/register is free and includes 2,000 tokens (no credit card); the key is shown on https://newsapi.ai/dashboard.
- Base URL: `https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/...` (the same paths also work on `https://newsapi.ai`). Text-analytics endpoints live on `https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/...`. Send `POST` requests with a JSON body (`Content-Type: application/json`); `GET` with query parameters also works for simple calls.
- Most-used endpoints: `/api/v1/article/getArticles` (search articles), `/api/v1/event/getEvents` (search events), `/api/v1/suggestConceptsFast` (turn a name into a concept URI). Prefer concept URIs (e.g. `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla,_Inc.`) over keywords: they match an entity in every language.
- Costs: searching recent data (last 30 days) costs 1 token per article search and 5 per event search; searching the archive costs 5 / 20 tokens per searched year. A search returns at most 100 articles or 50 events per page.
- Limits: at most 5 simultaneous requests per user (HTTP 429 otherwise); make requests sequentially. HTTP 401/403 mean the token limit was reached or the key/IP is disabled.
- Complex boolean queries use the `query` parameter with a MongoDB-like JSON (`$query` with `$and` / `$or` / `$not`, plus an optional `$filter`); it cannot be combined with the simple `keyword`, `conceptUri`, ... parameters in the same request.

## Docs

- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://newsapi.ai/llms-full.txt): this index plus the complete endpoint reference, query language and data models in one Markdown file
- [Documentation introduction](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=introduction): API keys, response codes, rate limits, query-condition limits, token costs, SDKs
- [Terminology](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=terminology): articles, events, concepts, categories (IPTC, DMOZ, News taxonomies), sources, locations
- [Search query language](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=query_language): simple parameters vs. the advanced JSON query language with `$and` / `$or` / `$not` and `$filter`
- [Keyword search modes](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=keyword_search_options): `phrase` (default), `exact` (Boolean AND/OR/NOT, NEAR/x, NEXT/x) and `simple` (relevance-based) matching
- [Data models](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=data_models): fields of the returned article, event, concept, category, source and location objects
- [Supported languages](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=supported_languages): ISO 639-3 codes for the `lang` parameter (eng, deu, fra, spa, zho, ...)
- [OpenAPI specification](https://newsapi.ai/static/api.yaml): YAML description of the REST endpoints
- [MCP integration](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=newsapi_mcp): use NewsAPI.ai from Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and other MCP clients: the hosted server `https://mcp.newsapi.ai/mcp` (OAuth sign-in) or locally `npx -y newsapi-mcp` with the `NEWSAPI_KEY` environment variable

## Articles

- [Get articles](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchArticles): search articles by keyword, concept, category, source, author, location, language, date, sentiment and more; also returns aggregates (timeline, top concepts, sources, sentiment, ...)
- [Get articles for topic page](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchArticlesForTopic): articles matching a topic page saved in the Event Registry web app
- [Get article details](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=articleDetails): full information about one or more articles by article URI
- [Stream of new articles](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=feedOfArticles): articles added in the last minutes, for real-time ingestion

## Events

- [Get events](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchEvents): search events (clusters of articles in any language about the same real-world happening)
- [Get events for a topic page](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchEventsForTopic): events matching a saved topic page
- [Get event details](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=eventDetails): an event's summary, articles, concepts, categories, similar events and other details
- [Stream of events](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=feedOfEvents): events added or updated in the last minutes
- [Breaking events](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=breakingEvents): events that are currently receiving a burst of new coverage

## Signal Types

- [Get mentions](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchMentions): sentence-level mentions of real-world developments, classified into Signal Types (event types), with facticity (fact / opinion / forecast), entities and sentiment
- [Suggest event types](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggEventTypes): find the URI of a Signal Type by name
- [Signal Types overview](https://newsapi.ai/signal-types): the 136+ Signal Types across Business, Society and Environment, and their use cases

## Autosuggest (name to URI)

- [Suggest concepts](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggConcepts): concept URI for a person, organization, location or thing
- [Suggest categories](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggCategories): category URI (IPTC, DMOZ or News taxonomy)
- [Suggest sources](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggSources): source URI for a publisher name or domain
- [Suggest authors](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggAuthors): author URI for a journalist's name
- [Suggest locations](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggLocations): location URI for a place name

## Text analytics

- [Annotate](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=annotate): identify people, organizations, locations and concepts in your own text, linked to Wikipedia
- [Categorize](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=categorize): classify text into the category taxonomies
- [Semantic similarity](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=semanticSimilarity): similarity of two documents, also across languages
- [Sentiment](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=sentiment): sentiment of a text
- [Extract article information](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=extractArticleInfo): title, body, authors, date and image from an article URL
- [Detect language](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=detectLanguage): language of a text

## SDKs and tools

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/EventRegistry/event-registry-python): `pip install eventregistry`; [wiki with guides](https://github.com/EventRegistry/event-registry-python/wiki)
- [Node.js SDK](https://github.com/EventRegistry/event-registry-node-js): `npm install eventregistry`
- [NewsAPI.ai MCP server](https://github.com/EventRegistry/newsapi-mcp): MCP tools `suggest`, `search` (articles, events or mentions), `get_breaking_events`, `get_topic_page_articles`, `get_topic_page_events`, `get_api_usage`
- [API sandbox](https://newsapi.ai/documentation/sandbox): build and run requests in the browser
- [Code examples](https://newsapi.ai/documentation/examples): ready-made requests for common tasks

## Pricing

- [Plans](https://newsapi.ai/plans): monthly token plans; free tier of 2,000 tokens on registration
- [Token usage](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=introduction): how many tokens each type of request costs (recent vs. archive, searches, aggregates, text analytics)
- [API usage endpoint](https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=usage): `/api/v1/usage` returns the available and used tokens of your key
